text: {"label":"Stimulus Equivalence Class Formation","definition":"Conceptual, experimental, and translational research on how stimulus equivalence classes and other emergent stimulus relations form, are maintained, and transfer functions, including the procedural variables and measures that affect them.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Focuses on emergent, untrained relations among stimuli in equivalence classes, not general stimulus control by reinforcement, operant variability and response patterning, or competing stimulus assessments."}
